Indicates whether `xpm init` templates accept a single parameter.

## Signature

```typescript
singleParameterXpmInitTemplate: boolean;
```

## Remarks

Legacy behavior (before 0.22.0): init templates accepted only a single parameter combining template name and optional arguments.

Modern behavior (0.22.0+): init templates support multiple parameters for more flexible template initialization and configuration.

Set to `true` for packages with minimumXpmRequired &lt; 0.22.0.
